escenas.texto: This week in Oceania, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over fifty-three million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Oceania edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Oceania. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured this Wednesday. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Number ten, Kubz Scouts, with “bro what did i just play”. Over six hundred and forty-eight thousand views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over twenty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.
Coming in at number nine, from Australia, TGG, with a video posted six days ago. Over six hundred and sixty-nine thousand views. It also has over one thousand comments.

Number eight, from Australia, Skill Up, with “I strongly recommend: Phantom Blade Zero Review”. Over six hundred and ninety-five thousand views. A video over twenty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.

Number seven, from Australia, Bundun, with “I Hid in Famous Roblox Games No One Noticed...”. Over seven hundred and four thousand views. A video over twenty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.
Next up, number six, from Australia, Ken, with “Mirror Evolution”. Over seven hundred and sixty-eight thousand views. It got there in just two days. It also has over one thousand comments.

Next up, number five, from New Zealand, Dolan Darkest, with “How Are These People Real”. Over nine hundred and twenty-seven thousand views. It got there in just two days. It also has over two thousand comments.
In position number four, from Australia, Stimpee, with “The New DayZ Badlands DLC is Brutal”. Over one million views. It also has over one thousand comments.

Bronze medal, from Australia, EYstreem, with “I Survived 100 Days as VERITY in Minecraft”. Over one point four million views. A video over twenty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has seven hundred and ten comments.

Silver medal, Bloxy Productions, with “Most embarrassing moments on your shirt”. Over six point eight million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and thirty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has three hundred and eighty comments.

Drum roll, please. Number one most viewed, Merry Latte, with “Comment STRAW if you NEED one!”. Over ten million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about ninety thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-nine thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. In position number ten, from Australia, Rival, with “Riot better lock in”. Nine hundred and eighty-six comments. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and eighty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It got there in just one day.

Coming in at number nine, from Australia, Phoenix SC, with “The new Jukebox is getting memed so bad.”. Over one thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over four hundred and thirty thousand views.
In position number eight, from Australia, Stimpee, with “The New DayZ Badlands DLC is Brutal”. Over one thousand comments. It also has over one million views.

Number seven, from Australia, Bundun, with “I Hid in Famous Roblox Games No One Noticed...”. Over one thousand comments. A video over twenty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.
Number six, from Australia, Ken, with “what”. Over one thousand comments. It also has over seven hundred and sixty thousand views.

Next up, number five, from Australia, Bub Games, with “trolling serious military roleplayers in gta...”. Over one thousand comments. It got there in just two days. It also has over four hundred and ninety-three thousand views.
At number four, from Australia, TGG, with a video posted six days ago. Over one thousand comments. It also has over six hundred and sixty-nine thousand views.

Bronze medal, Kubz Scouts, with “bro what did i just play”. Over one thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over twenty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Silver medal, from Australia, Skill Up, with “I strongly recommend: Phantom Blade Zero Review”. Over two thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about sixteen thousand views per hour. A video over twenty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

And finally, number one most commented, from New Zealand, Dolan Darkest, with “How Are These People Real”. Over two thousand comments. It got there in just two days. It also has over nine hundred and twenty-seven thousand views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. At number ten, from Australia, PetracoreProxy Dev Channel, with “Mortal Kombat 1 Haru Urara Fan-Made Teaser Trailer Uma Musume”. Over eleven thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. And get this: it's a channel with about twenty-three thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

Coming in at number nine, from Australia, Phoenix SC, with “The new Jukebox is getting memed so bad.”. Over thirteen thousand likes. It got there in just one day. It also has over four hundred and thirty thousand views.

At number eight, from Australia, Skill Up, with “I strongly recommend: Phantom Blade Zero Review”. Over fourteen thousand likes. A video over twenty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.
Next up, number seven, from Australia, TGG, with a video posted six days ago. Over sixteen thousand likes. It also has over six hundred and sixty-nine thousand views.
Next up, number six, from Australia, Ken, with “what”. Over twenty-two thousand likes. It also has over seven hundred and sixty thousand views.

In position number five, from New Zealand, Dolan Darkest, with “Steam Needs to Take This Seriously”. Over twenty-three thousand likes. It got there in just one day. It also has over seven hundred and seventy-four thousand views.
At number four, from Australia, Stimpee, with “The New DayZ Badlands DLC is Brutal”. Over twenty-three thousand likes. It also has over one million views.

Bronze medal, Kubz Scouts, with “bro what did i just play”. Over twenty-six thousand likes. A video over twenty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over six hundred and forty-eight thousand views.

Silver medal, Merry Latte, with “Comment STRAW if you NEED one!”. Over fifty-two thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about ninety thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-nine thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

And finally, number one most liked, Bloxy Productions, with “Most embarrassing moments on your shirt”. Over one hundred and eighty-nine thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and thirty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over six point eight million views.

And some news: starting week forty-five we add TikTok. The ten most viral TikTok videos of the week, right here too. Don't miss it. And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Asia. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Oceania every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
